selection.edition: international Bright Data Account, Dataset, Scraper, SERP, Unlocker, Archive, and Deep Lookup API
selection.ownership: Bright Data Ltd. is an Israeli private company (company 514114842) headquartered at 4 Hamahshev Street, Netanya, Israel, formerly Luminati Networks, owned by EMK Capital. The reviewed edition is the public REST API at api.brightdata.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Bright Data Bearer authentication, GET /status, GET /datasets/list, GET /datasets/{dataset_id}/metadata, GET /datasets/views, Israeli Netanya identity, Master Service Agreement, and dated incident search (Bright Data / Luminati + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. GET /status is the pinned credential validator and is used as healthcheck. Dataset filter/trigger/download and snapshot-parts delivery are omitted as billed collection. Include Security June 2026 SDK/residential-proxy research and the X Corp. scraping litigation are recorded; neither is a documented customer API-key compromise of api.brightdata.com. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international Bright Data Account and Marketplace Dataset API
research.searchCoverage: Official Bright Data REST API at https://api.brightdata.com with Authorization Bearer. GET /status is the cheap authenticated account-status probe used by the pinned validator. Marketplace list/metadata/views are catalog reads. Scrape trigger, filter, snapshot download, and Web Unlocker/SERP are billed and omitted. Bright Data Ltd. is Netanya, Israel. Dated 2026-09-13 incident search found no qualifying customer-account compromise of api.brightdata.com. The June 2026 Include Security SDK/residential-proxy report and X Corp. litigation are recorded separately from API-key compromise.

account.status.get.description: Fetch Bright Data account status for the connected API key.
account.status.get.title: Get account status

countries.list.description: List country codes available for each static proxy zone type via GET /countrieslist.
countries.list.title: List available countries

customer.balance.get.description: Get current and pending Bright Data account balances. Requires an API key with Admin permission.
customer.balance.get.title: Get customer balance

dataset.views.list.description: List Bright Data dataset views available to the connected account.
dataset.views.list.title: List dataset views

datasets.crawl.trigger.description: Start an asynchronous dataset or site crawl. Poll snapshot_id with snapshots.progress.get, then download with snapshots.results.get.

custom_output_fields.description: Pipe-separated output fields to include, such as url|title.

dataset_id.description: Dataset or crawler ID to run.

include_errors.description: Include an error report with the results.

items.description: Crawler or scraper input objects. Fields vary by dataset; URL crawlers commonly require url.

datasets.crawl.trigger.title: Start site crawl

datasets.deep_lookup.results.get.description: Retrieve enriched records plus progress, cost, and provider metadata for a completed Deep Lookup request.

request_id.description: Completed Deep Lookup request_id whose records should be retrieved.

datasets.deep_lookup.results.get.title: Get Deep Lookup results

datasets.deep_lookup.status.get.description: Check a Deep Lookup request's status, progress, cost, and provider metadata. Poll until completion before retrieving results.

request_id.description: Deep Lookup request_id returned when the lookup was started.

datasets.deep_lookup.status.get.title: Get Deep Lookup status

datasets.deep_lookup.trigger.description: Start an asynchronous Deep Lookup research request and return its request_id. Billing is per matched record.

columns.description: Columns to enrich or constrain for every matched Deep Lookup record.

name.description: Machine-readable name for the requested entity collection.

query.description: Research query. Bright Data requires it to begin with 'Find all'.

result_limit.description: Maximum number of matched, billable records to return.

title.description: Optional human-readable title for the lookup.

datasets.deep_lookup.trigger.title: Start Deep Lookup

datasets.filter.description: Create a billable filtered marketplace-dataset snapshot. Use records_limit to cap included records. File uploads are not sent.

dataset_id.description: ID of the dataset to filter.

filter.description: Filter criteria. Basic: {name, operator, value}. Combine with {operator: and|or, filters: [...]}.

records_limit.description: Optional maximum number of records to include in the snapshot.

datasets.filter.title: Filter dataset

datasets.list.description: List Bright Data marketplace datasets available to the connected account.
datasets.list.title: List datasets

datasets.metadata.get.description: Fetch Bright Data marketplace dataset field metadata for a dataset ID.
datasets.metadata.get.title: Get dataset metadata

datasets.scrape.description: Scrape up to 20 input objects synchronously. Requests exceeding the one-minute limit fall back to an asynchronous snapshot.

custom_output_fields.description: Pipe-separated output fields to return, such as title|final_price|url.

dataset_id.description: Dataset ID whose scraper should process the inputs.

format.description: Response format. Bright Data defaults to JSON when omitted.

include_errors.description: Whether the response should include an errors report.

items.description: One to 20 input objects accepted by the selected dataset.

limit_per_input.description: Maximum records returned for each input.

datasets.scrape.title: Scrape data synchronously

healthcheck.description: Validate the Bright Data API key by reading account status.
healthcheck.title: Healthcheck

scrapers.list.description: List account-owned Scraper Studio scrapers and discover collector IDs.

search.description: Optional term used to filter scrapers by name.

scrapers.list.title: List Scraper Studio scrapers

serp.results.get.description: Retrieve JSON or raw results for an asynchronous serp.search request. HTTP 202 means the job is still pending.

response_id.description: Async SERP response ID returned by serp.search.

result_format.description: Expected result format. Match the format used in serp.search. Not sent on the wire.

zone.description: Optional SERP zone name when the provider requires it for result retrieval.

serp.results.get.title: Get SERP results

serp.search.description: Submit an asynchronous SERP search and return its response_id. Retrieve it with serp.results.get. search_engine and data_format are accepted and not mapped onto POST /serp/req.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code for localized results.

data_format.description: Optional transformation. Accepted and not sent on POST /serp/req.

format.description: Provider response format requested for the async job. Sent as brd_json.

search_engine.description: Search engine to query. Accepted and not sent; the zone's configured engine is used.

zone.description: SERP API zone name. Use zones.list to discover configured zones.

serp.search.title: Search SERP

snapshots.progress.get.description: Check whether a dataset snapshot is running, ready, or failed before downloading it.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of the snapshot to check, typically s_ followed by hex.

snapshots.progress.get.title: Check snapshot status

snapshots.results.get.description: Download a completed dataset snapshot. Poll snapshots.progress.get before retrying a pending snapshot.

batch_size.description: Divide snapshot into batches of this size. Use with part.

compress.description: Whether to compress the result using gzip.

part.description: Which batch part to download (starts from 1).

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of the snapshot to fetch results for.

snapshots.results.get.title: Download snapshot results

unlocker.request.description: Scrape a public URL through Web Unlocker when ordinary requests are blocked or require JavaScript rendering.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the proxy location.

data_format.description: Set to markdown to convert page content to markdown format.

format.description: Response format. raw returns HTML; json returns structured data.

url.description: The URL of the website to unlock and scrape.

zone.description: Web Unlocker zone name. Call zones.list first to get available zones.

unlocker.request.title: Scrape protected URL

webarchive.search.create.description: Search Bright Data's Web Archive and estimate matching files, dump size, and dump cost. filters must include max_age or both min_date and max_date.

filters.description: Required archive filters. A search needs max_age, or both min_date and max_date.

webarchive.search.create.title: Search web archive

webarchive.search.get.description: Get a Web Archive search's status and its matching-file, dump-size, and dump-cost estimates.

search_id.description: Archive search identifier returned by webarchive.search.create.

webarchive.search.get.title: Get web archive search

zones.bandwidth.get.description: Get uploaded, downloaded, and total byte usage for one zone and date range.

from_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 start date or timestamp for the usage window.

to_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 end date or timestamp for the usage window.

zones.bandwidth.get.title: Get zone bandwidth

zones.cities.list.description: List static-network cities available for a country and proxy pool type.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to list available cities for.

pool_ip_type.description: Type of static proxy pool. dc for datacenter, static_res for residential/ISP.

zones.cities.list.title: List available cities

zones.cost.get.description: Get invoice-aligned billed cost and bandwidth for one zone and date range. The to_date boundary is exclusive.

from_date.description: Inclusive start date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format.

to_date.description: Exclusive end date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format; use the first day after the desired period.

zones.cost.get.title: Get zone cost

zones.create.description: Create a durable SERP API zone using Bright Data's safe SERP plan (zone.type=serp, plan.type=unblocker, plan.serp=true). product=scraping_browser is accepted and still provisions a SERP zone; Browser API plan mapping is not applied.

country.description: Lowercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or any.

custom_headers.description: Allow custom request headers in the new zone.

name.description: Name for the new Bright Data zone.

product.description: Safe product to provision. scraping_browser is accepted; this operation always sends the official SERP plan.

solve_captcha_disable.description: For SERP zones, disable Bright Data captcha solving.

zones.create.title: Create safe zone

zones.list.description: List configured zones and their types, including Web Unlocker, SERP, and Scraping Browser zones.
zones.list.title: List unlocker zones
